meta.name: qwen-wordbank
meta.zh: Qwen-Image 2.1 资产提示词取词库
meta.source: 抽自 ComfyUI-Luori-Sunset（data/lr/*.json，93 字段 / 数百选项，原为 Z-Image 中文词库），按本技能的三类资产重新裁剪、改写成英文
meta.rule: 一个槽取一个词（或一个词族），不堆同义词；三类资产各有固定槽位顺序；每条资产只出一条提示词
meta.scope: 只服务资产定设图（人物 / 场景 / 道具）。视频镜头的运镜与光影见 01 / 06，不在这里取。

slots.note: 一句收尾；人物用 85mm 中近景，场景用 24–35mm，道具用 100mm 微距
terms: shot on an 85mm prime lens at eye level
a 50mm lens, neutral perspective, no distortion
shallow depth of field, the subject fully in focus
deep focus from front to back
a still frame from a digital cinema camera
a documentary photograph, available light only
shot on 35mm film, fine grain, gentle halation
a medium-format digital capture, clean micro-contrast
hand-held framing with a slight natural tilt
slots.example: Shot on an 85mm prime lens at eye level, shallow depth of field, the face fully in focus.

slots.note: 开场必须交代；本技能一律要「照片」，不要 3D/CG/插画
slots.example: A photographic character reference sheet of …

slots.note: 每类资产挑 2–3 个，专治 AI 塑料感；不要一次列十个
terms: visible pores on the nose and cheeks
fine baby hairs along the hairline
a few faint freckles across the bridge of the nose
slight natural asymmetry between the left and right side
a small healed scar above one eyebrow
skin with a faint sheen, not airbrushed
thin creases at the outer corners of the eyes
a light uneven tan on the forearms
fabric with soft pilling and a faded edge
fingernails with natural wear at the tips
dust settled in the seams and corners
water stains and a chipped edge on the surface
a scuffed, unevenly polished area from use
slots.example: Visible pores on the nose and cheeks, fine baby hairs along the hairline, slight natural asymmetry between the two sides of the face.

slots.note: 人物/道具用干净背景；场景本身就是背景，不取这一槽
terms: against a plain seamless light-grey studio background
against a plain off-white sweep, no props
on a neutral mid-grey backdrop with a soft floor shadow
on a matte dark-grey surface, the background falling off to black
centred on an empty pale plaster wall
on a clean workbench top, the background kept empty
slots.example: Against a plain seamless light-grey studio background.

slots.note: 写进提示词反而变糊，或与短剧调性冲突
terms: 8K / ultra HD / masterpiece / award-winning / highly detailed / best quality
in the style of an anime, 3D render, CGI, illustration, digital painting
text, watermark, logo, signature, UI elements, subtitle bars
beauty filter, plastic skin, airbrushed, doll-like
extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands
readable Chinese or English lettering on any surface
lens flare covering the face, heavy vignette
in-frame borders, frames within frames, collage
slots.example: No text, no watermark, no logo, no CGI look, no beauty filter.

character.zh: 人物资产（只写本体：骨相 / 五官 / 毛发 / 皮肤 / 身形 / 服装 / 配饰，无动作、无场景、无光位）

terms: a woman in her early twenties
a woman in her late thirties
a woman in her mid forties
a man in his late twenties
an elderly man in his seventies
slots.example: A woman in her late thirties.

slots.note: 只写「看得出来的地域外观」，不写国籍标签
terms: mixed East Asian and European features
slots.example: East Asian features.

terms: a soft round face with full cheeks
a heart-shaped face with a tapered chin
a diamond face with wide cheekbones
high cheekbones and a defined jawline
slots.example: A balanced oval face with high cheekbones and a defined jawline.

terms: narrow elongated eyes with a slight upturn
deep-set eyes under a heavy brow
double eyelids with a visible crease
a visible catchlight in both eyes
slots.example: Almond-shaped dark brown eyes with a visible catchlight.

terms: straight natural brows, slightly sparse at the tails
a straight nose with a rounded tip
a small bump on the bridge of the nose
slots.example: Straight natural brows, slightly sparse at the tails, and a straight nose with a rounded tip.

terms: a full upper lip and a defined cupid's bow
a wide mouth with upturned corners
dry lips with fine vertical lines
bare lips in a muted rose tone
slots.example: A full upper lip with a defined cupid's bow, bare in a muted rose tone.

slots.note: 肤色带修饰语；肤质必须带真实感（见 global.realism）
terms: an uneven tone with redness across the cheeks
a matte even complexion with a faint sheen on the T-zone
faint shadow of stubble along the jaw
skin with a light natural oil sheen
slots.example: A warm light-olive skin tone, matte with a faint sheen on the T-zone.

terms: a short bob ending at the jaw
hair tied in a low bun
slots.example: Shoulder-length hair.

terms: tousled with a few strands out of place
a centre part with face-framing pieces
slots.example: Straight and fine, a side-parted sweep, a few strands out of place.

terms: natural black with a cool sheen
bleached blonde with visible dark roots
slots.example: Natural black with a cool sheen.

slots.note: 写结构（肩宽/骨架/曲线），不写「身材很好」
terms: a soft hourglass curve with a defined waist
broad shoulders and a solid chest
long limbs and a small head
slots.example: A soft hourglass curve with a defined waist, average height.

terms: a uniform jacket with shoulder epaulettes
slots.example: A stiff-collared work shirt.
Pleated wool trousers.

slots.note: 材质必须具体；版型写「合身/宽松/垂坠」
terms: brushed cotton with a soft nap
heavy twill with a dry hand
washed denim with a faded lap
matte synthetic shell with taped seams
a fitted cut that follows the body
a loose drape that falls away from the body
double-stitched seams and a worn collar edge
slots.example: A coarse linen weave, slightly oversized and boxy, wrinkled from wear.

slots.note: 人物的「旧」靠衣服，不靠脸
terms: the collar softened and slightly greyed
a small mended tear at the elbow
a shadow of an old stain near the hem
the edge of the sleeve rolled and creased
slots.example: The collar softened and slightly greyed, a frayed cuff on one sleeve.

slots.note: 只写这位人物设定里真有的，最多 3 件；没有就不写
terms: a thin silver chain at the throat
a plain wedding band on the left hand
wire-rimmed glasses with a faint scratch on one lens
a cloth hair tie on the wrist
a canvas shoulder bag with a frayed strap
slots.example: A thin silver chain at the throat and a plain wedding band on the left hand.

terms: a small ink stain on one fingertip
a thin scar across the back of the hand
slots.example: Long fingers, short practical nails, a callus across the palm.

slots.note: 资产图不演戏：只给「中性 / 平静 / 微表情」，不许大笑大哭
terms: a level steady gaze into the lens
a faint tension at the jaw
a slight, tired downturn at the mouth corners
slots.example: A calm neutral expression, a level steady gaze into the lens.

scene.zh: 场景资产（空镜：无人物、无动作；空间 / 材质 / 陈设 / 痕迹 / 光 / 色彩）

slots.note: 越具体越好：不是「室内」，而是「老式派出所的讯问室」
terms: a narrow urban alley between brick buildings
a rented single room with a single bed
a village courtyard with a low brick wall
slots.example: A cramped old-style interrogation room.

slots.note: 时间要能推出光的颜色，别只写「白天」
terms: the last twenty minutes of daylight
dusk with the streetlights just on
slots.example: Deep night.

terms: wind pushing dust across the floor
slots.example: Rain just stopped, everything wet.

slots.note: 门窗梁柱楼梯，决定空间怎么被读出来
terms: a single high window with frosted glass
a barred window at the far end
a low doorway with a concrete lintel
an exposed pipe running along the ceiling
a metal staircase with open treads
a narrow service corridor with doors on one side
an interior with no visible exit
slots.example: A single high window with frosted glass, an exposed pipe running along the ceiling.

slots.note: 墙 / 地 / 顶各写一个，材质是分辨度
terms: walls of painted brick, the paint blistering
glazed ceramic tiles with dark grout
raw poured concrete with formwork marks
worn vinyl flooring lifting at the seams
slots.example: Walls of painted brick with blistering paint, an oiled hardwood floor, a ceiling of bare joists.

slots.note: 3–5 件，按方位摆（见 03 的方位清单），不要写满
terms: a metal table bolted to the floor
a chair with one broken slat
a steel locker with a padlock
a wall clock stopped at ten past two
a folding cot with a grey blanket
a kettle and two enamel cups
a torn poster half peeled off
a mirror with a taped corner
a floor drain with a rusted grate
a radiator with a towel over it
slots.example: A metal table bolted to the floor, a chair with one broken slat, a wall clock stopped at ten past two.

slots.note: 场景的「有人住过」全靠这一槽
terms: water stains spreading from the ceiling corner
a dark scuff line at the height of a shoulder
dust in every seam and on the window ledge
cigarette burns on the table edge
a patch of floor worn pale by foot traffic
grime built up along the skirting
something spilled and dried under the table
hairline cracks running up the wall
a rust bloom around every screw
slots.example: Water stains spreading from the ceiling corner, dust in every seam, a patch of floor worn pale.

slots.note: 来源 + 方向 + 质地 + 落点，一句写完
terms: a single bare bulb overhead, hard light, deep shadows under the table
flat fluorescent tubes, greenish, even and shadowless
cold daylight through frosted glass, soft and directionless
late sun raking in from the left, long shadows across the floor
a sodium street lamp outside, orange, pooling on the wet ground
light through a half-open door, a bright wedge on the floor
practical lamps only, warm pools with dark gaps between them
a phone screen lighting the nearest surface from below
slots.example: A single bare bulb overhead, hard light, deep shadows under the table.

slots.note: 主配色 2–3 个 + 色温；与剧的风格锁一致
terms: a muted palette of grey, dirty white and rust
cold blue-green shadows against warm skin tones in the doorways
high contrast, deep blacks and one warm accent
a warm amber interior against a cold blue exterior
slots.example: A muted palette of grey, dirty white and rust.

slots.note: 一条就够，能显著加真实度
terms: dust visible in the light beams
a slight haze that softens the far wall
slots.example: Dust visible in the light beams, a slight haze that softens the far wall.

prop.zh: 道具资产（单体，1:1，干净背景，无手无人）

slots.note: 先写它是什么、做什么用，再写长什么样
terms: a folding pocket knife with a worn wooden handle
a leather-bound notebook with a broken spine
a pair of worn leather work gloves
a brass house key on a red string
a cassette recorder with a cracked case
a glass vial of clear liquid
a stack of banknotes held by a rubber band
slots.example: A folding pocket knife with a worn wooden handle.

terms: cast iron with a pitted surface
aged paper with a soft deckle edge
slots.example: Cast iron with a pitted surface.

terms: machined with fine concentric tool marks
sand-cast, the parting line still there
slots.example: Hand-forged, hammer marks visible.

slots.note: 给一个可比的对象，模型才知道多大
terms: about the length of a forearm
small enough to close a fist around
roughly the size of a paperback book
tall enough to reach the knee
slots.example: No longer than a palm.

terms: high polish with hard specular highlights
a dull patina over the whole surface
lacquered, the edges rubbed back to bare metal
translucent, light passing through the body
slots.example: A dull patina over the whole surface.

slots.note: 新道具也要有一点点，否则像 3D 渲染
terms: a deep scratch across the face
a hairline crack near the rim
the plating worn through at the corners
a ring-shaped stain from a wet glass
slots.example: The edges rounded by handling, a deep scratch across the face.

slots.note: 唯一标识：刻字/编号/缺口/线头。**不要可读的品牌名**（只写「磨花的刻字」）
terms: an engraved initial, worn almost smooth
a chipped corner on one side
a repaired split held by two staples
a folded corner marking a place
a single drop of dried red on the edge
slots.example: An engraved initial worn almost smooth, a chipped corner on one side.

terms: hard direct light from the upper left, a single sharp highlight along the top edge
soft even studio light, gentle falloff on both sides
backlit rim, the body mostly in shadow
a small specular point where the surface catches the lamp
light passing through, the colour deepening at the thick end
slots.example: Hard direct light from the upper left, a single sharp highlight along the top edge.

quota.zh: 取词配额（超了就是堆砌，会互相打架）
quota.character: 18 槽里挑 12–16 槽；每槽 1 个词（或 1 个词族 2–3 个词）。配饰最多 3 件，真实感瑕疵 2–3 个
quota.scene: 10 槽里挑 8–10 槽；陈设 3–5 件，痕迹 2–3 条，光 1 句
quota.prop: 8 槽全用，每槽 1 个词；痕迹 1–2 条，特征细节 1–2 条
quota.words: 英文单段 350–500 词（人物 / 场景）/ 300–450 词（道具）；低于下限说明细节不足，高于上限是在堆砌
